notes.title: Santa's Christmas Solitaire 2 Out Now!
notes.notes:
Our latest game, Santa's Christmas Solitaire 2, has been released on Steam ːsteamhappyː

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1202710/Santas_Christmas_Solitaire_2]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1202710/Santas_Christmas_Solitaire_2[/url]

Cheers,

notes.title: v1.06 Update
notes.notes:
v1.06 is live!
[list]
[*]Defaulted the game to Window mode
[*]Updated game engine to use new DirectX if available 
[*]Added even more logging to help debugging issues
[/list]

A big THANK YOU to Frankbrodie for helping us debug and test  

If you have any issues with this build, please let us know via the forums. 

Cheers, 
Steve and Kylie 
The Revills Games

notes.title: Please help us get Chef Solitaire: USA on Steam via Greenlight
notes.notes:
Hi All!

Thanks for all the support so far :)

We have just added our latest game, Chef Solitaire: USA to Greenlight and we would really appreciate if you could Yes vote it to help get it on Steam! Click the link below to go to the Greenlight page:

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=540637352]Chef Solitaire USA Greenlight[/url]


In Legends of Solitaire: Curse of the Dragons news we are working on a small patch to sync up ingame achievements with Steam achievements if you lose your Steam connection whilst playing and also fixing a few small bugs.

Thanks,
Steve and Kylie
The Revills Games

notes.title: v1.03 Update
notes.notes:
[h1]New Features and Fixes:[/h1]

[list]
    [*]Added Round Select Dialog
    [*]Added Map button to the in-game options
    [*]Fixed objectives text when changing languages
[/list]

[b]Note:[/b] If you change the chapter you are currently playing the game will reset the stats and objectives. A dialog is shown to warn you about this.

Thanks,
Steve and Kylie
[b]The Revills Games[/b]
